name: Sections before Article 1
scope: article N.C. Gen. Stat. ch. 132 art. 0 (North Carolina General Assembly, whole-chapter pages)

notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final
hearing.quote_through: In any proceeding pursuant to this subsection, the following persons shall be notified and those persons, or their designated representative, shall be given an opportunity to be heard at any proceeding:

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer
appeal.quote_through: If the court determines that the person is not authorized to receive disclosure pursuant to subsection (c) of this section, there shall be no right of appeal and the petitioner may file an action for release pursuant to subsection (g) of this section.

access.label: The person can see the record
access.quote_through: (a) Databases purchased, leased, created, or otherwise acquired by every public agency containing public records shall be designed and maintained in a manner that does not impair or impede the public agency's ability to permit the public inspection and examination of public recor

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire
waiver.quote: (c) Article 17 of Chapter 120 of the General Statutes shall govern all records and information of the legislative branch which shall be exempt from this Chapter, including documents as defined by G.S.

symmetry.label: Binds individuals harder than institutions
symmetry.qi: Any person who violates this subsection shall be guilty of an infraction, punishable by a fine not to exceed five hundred dollars ($500.00) for each violation.

boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that
boundary.quote_takes: The register of deeds or the Department of the Secretary of State may not reject an instrument presented for recording because the instrument contains an individual's personal information.
boundary.quote_limits: The contract by which a political subdivision of this State agrees not to disclose information deemed confidential under State law shall be a public record, unless the existence of the contract is also deemed confidential under State law.

plain-words.label: Can an ordinary reader follow it
plain-words.quote_longest: Notwithstanding the provisions of this subsection, if the request is such as to require extensive use of information technology resources or extensive clerical or supervisory assistance by personnel of the agency involved, or if producing the record in the medium requested result

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: Any person who violates this subsection shall be guilty of an infraction, punishable by a fine not to exceed five hundred dollars ($500.00) for each violation.
fair-exchange.quote_gets: provided that the original shall be provided under process to be used as evidence in any relevant civil or criminal proceeding.
